summary_en: 450,000 shares (1.63% of S/O ex-treasury), ¥800M ceiling, open-market acquisition, 31 Jul–31 Oct 2026. Rationale: support dividend policy and capital-efficiency targets under medium-term plan to FY3/28 targeting 70% payout ratio.
title_en: Notice Regarding Determination of Matters Concerning Acquisition of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief: Airman Corporation announced on 30 July 2026 that its board has authorized acquisition of up to 450,000 treasury shares (1.63% of the 27,559,112 shares outstanding ex-treasury as of 31 March 2026) with a ceiling of ¥800 million. The acquisition will be conducted via open-market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange between 31 July and 31 October 2026. The company stated that the buyback supports its capital allocation policy as set out in the medium-term vision through FY3/28, which targets a total payout ratio of 70% through dividends and treasury-stock acquisition, with a dividend scale of approximately ¥10 billion.
